standard_prerequisites.name: The behaviour of depth along a short exact sequence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 2051-2054)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the inequality for the quotient.

core_obligations: Inequality: the short exact sequence relating the module to its quotient by the element gives the stated lower bound on the depth of the quotient (proof lines 2050-2054)

Equality: a regular sequence for the quotient, preceded by the chosen element, is regular for the module, which gives the reverse inequality and hence (1); (2) follows formally (proof lines 2055-2057)
proof_roadmap: 由短正合列 0 → M → M → M/xM → 0 与 depth 在短正合列中的行为，得 depth_I(M/xM) ≥ depth_I(M) − 1。
反向：若 x_1,…,x_r 是 M/xM 的正则序列，则 x, x_1,…,x_r 是 M 的正则序列 ⇒ depth 不等式反向 ⇒ (1)。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for an element of the ideal behaving regularly on a module the depth of the quotient drops by at most one, with a second formal consequence (author lemma at source lines 2038-2048, label lemma-depth-drops-by-one). The proof (source lines 2050-2058) obtains one inequality from the depth behaviour along a short exact sequence and the other by prepending the element to a regular sequence for the quotient (proof lines 2050-2057). The two inequalities are the content. H3.
